content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Shreveport

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's formal eligibility criteria—typically a bachelor's degree plus years of direct project experience, or equivalent—before applying. Granite PM Academy's enrollment advisors can help you verify your qualifications align with PMI standards.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Attend all required contact hours delivered over weeks of interactive online sessions. This formal education covers the PMBOK® Guide, exam domains, and real-world applications—a mandatory step before you can submit your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, complete your official PMI application online, documenting your project experience and education. Pay PMI's application and exam fee directly to PMI. Allow time for PMI to review and approve your submission before scheduling your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice exams and focused review sessions. Schedule your proctored PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. Granite PM Academy instructors remain available to clarify concepts and build your confidence before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll earn the PMP® credential valid for three years. During your renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through PMI-approved education, volunteer work, or authorship. Renew with PMI before expiration to keep your certification active and competitive in Shreveport's job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
